'''The Outer Rim decks''' are constructed Star Wars CCG lists published on the [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] GeoCities site (<code>geocities.com/ev9d11</code>). The SWCCG index grouped them as Expanded Universe, DS II & Beyond, and Pre Special Ed. Pre Special Ed (<code>TheOuterRim/cdeck/Decks.html</code>) did not survive on the live mirror or on Wayback.

Classic lists keep the published title, the author handle, the card list, and a [[GEMP importable decklist|GEMP Importable deck]] download.

A parent catalog of published 60s is [[Decklists]].

== Young Jedi ==

The same GeoCities account hosted Young Jedi Deck Effect lists (Jedi vs Sith, Arena of Honor, EBON, Duel of the Fates, and set folders). Those lists stay on the archived HTML. The interviews index is [https://web.archive.org/web/20011122015220/http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/YoungJedi/Interviews/interviews.htm interviews.htm] (Wayback, 22 November 2001).
